This Quarto notebook is the canonical executable source for
`scripts/build_16s_return_package.qmd`. It collects exactly what the
manuscript stream asked for in `notes/handoff-2026-08-20-16s-collaborator.md`,
records an MD5 for every returned file, and writes an integration-note
skeleton that separates robust observations from fragile ones.

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/build_16s_return_package.qmd [derived_root] [output_dir]
```

Automatic execution during rendering is disabled because this workflow writes
project outputs.

```{r}
#| label: build-16s-return-package
#| echo: true
abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
derived_root <- if (length(args) >= 1L) args[[1L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_DERIVED")
output_dir <- if (length(args) >= 2L) args[[2L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_RETURN_DIR")
if (!nzchar(derived_root) || !nzchar(output_dir)) {
  abort("Provide derived_root and output_dir, or source config/16s_analysis_paths.sh first.")
}
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

wanted <- data.frame(
  contract_item = c(
    "software_and_database_provenance", "primer_removal_qc", "truncation_decision",
    "read_retention_qc", "denoising_parameters", "asv_counts_unrarefied",
    "asv_taxonomy_silva", "taxonomy_crosscheck_gtdb", "sample_metadata",
    "representative_sequences", "phyloseq_object", "family_profile",
    "alpha_diversity", "beta_ordination", "beta_permanova", "phase_structure_check",
    "interpretation_guards", "exploratory_differential_abundance", "figure_registry"
  ),
  source_path = file.path(derived_root, c(
    "16s_software_provenance.tsv",
    "01_primer_removal/16s_primer_removal_report.tsv",
    "02_quality_profiles/16s_truncation_planning.tsv",
    "03_dada2/16s_read_retention.tsv",
    "03_dada2/16s_dada2_parameters.tsv",
    "05_phyloseq/16s_asv_counts_unrarefied.tsv",
    "05_phyloseq/16s_asv_taxonomy_silva138.2.tsv",
    "04_taxonomy/16s_taxonomy_concordance.tsv",
    "05_phyloseq/16s_sample_data.tsv",
    "05_phyloseq/16s_asv_representative_sequences.fasta",
    "05_phyloseq/16s_phyloseq.rds",
    "06_ecology/16s_family_profile_long.tsv",
    "06_ecology/16s_alpha_diversity.tsv",
    "06_ecology/16s_beta_ordination_coordinates.tsv",
    "06_ecology/16s_beta_permanova.tsv",
    "06_ecology/16s_phase_structure_check.tsv",
    "06_ecology/16s_interpretation_guards.tsv",
    "07_exploratory_differential_abundance/16s_exploratory_differential_abundance.tsv",
    "08_figures/16s_figure_candidate_registry.tsv"
  )),
  requirement = c(rep("required", 17), "optional", "required"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

wanted$present <- file.exists(wanted$source_path)
missing_required <- wanted[wanted$requirement == "required" & !wanted$present, ]

figure_dir <- file.path(derived_root, "08_figures")
figures <- list.files(figure_dir, pattern = "\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)

copy_into <- function(paths) {
  copied <- character(0)
  for (path in paths) {
    if (!file.exists(path)) next
    target <- file.path(output_dir, basename(path))
    file.copy(path, target, overwrite = TRUE)
    copied <- c(copied, target)
  }
  copied
}
copied <- copy_into(c(wanted$source_path[wanted$present], figures))

checksums <- tools::md5sum(copied)
manifest <- data.frame(
  file = basename(names(checksums)),
  bytes = file.size(names(checksums)),
  md5 = unname(checksums),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
manifest <- manifest[order(manifest$file), ]
write.table(manifest, file.path(output_dir, "16s_return_package_manifest.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(wanted, file.path(output_dir, "16s_return_package_contract.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

note_path <- file.path(output_dir, "16s_integration_note.md")
if (!file.exists(note_path)) {
  writeLines(c(
    "# 16S integration note",
    "",
    sprintf("Prepared: %s", format(Sys.Date())),
    "",
    "## What the analysis did",
    "",
    "One paragraph: substrate, primer removal, denoising, taxonomy, and the",
    "exact experimental boundary carried through every statement below.",
    "",
    "## Robust observations",
    "",
    "- Observations that hold under both Bray-Curtis and Aitchison views and do",
    "  not depend on a single sample or a single parameter choice.",
    "",
    "## Fragile signals",
    "",
    "- Observations that change with depth, prevalence filtering, or the choice",
    "  of dissimilarity. State what would settle them.",
    "",
    "## Analyses that must not enter the manuscript",
    "",
    "- Anything framed as a replicated causal treatment effect.",
    "- Exploratory differential abundance quoted as a confirmatory result.",
    "",
    "## Suggested manuscript use",
    "",
    "- Whether the result is informative enough to occupy the conditional",
    "  Figure 5 slot, or belongs in the supplement, or should not be used.",
    "",
    "## Open questions for the manuscript stream",
    "",
    "- ..."
  ), note_path)
}

print(manifest)
if (nrow(missing_required)) {
  cat("\nMissing required contract items:\n")
  print(missing_required[, c("contract_item", "source_path")])
  abort("The return package is incomplete. Run the missing steps before returning it.")
}
cat(sprintf("\nReturn package assembled in %s\n", output_dir))
cat("Complete 16s_integration_note.md by hand before returning. It is the part of the\n")
cat("package that a table cannot generate.\n")
```
